# `modules/PrefabLibrary.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/PrefabLibrary.js`

PrefabManager.js - Folder-based Prefab System (File-based) Based on J:\game2 implementation - proper file persistence Every entity folder is a prefab that can be: - Exported to Assets/Prefabs/*.prefab.json - Imported/instantiated into any scene - Updated (re-export overwrites) - Listed and browsed

## Functions

### `exportFolderAsPrefab(editor, folderId)`

Export a folder as a prefab data structure

### `setCollabPrefabHooks(onSave, onDelete)`

### `async savePrefabToFile(editor, prefab)`

Save prefab to Assets/Prefabs/ directory

### `async exportFolder(editor, folderId)`

Export folder and save to file (combined operation)

### `async listPrefabs(editor)`

List all available prefabs in Assets/Prefabs/

### `async loadPrefabFile(editor, fileName)`

Load prefab from file

### `async loadPrefabByUUID(editor, uuid)`

Load prefab by UUID

### `instantiatePrefab(editor, prefab, targetFolderId = null, offset = [0, 0, 0])`

Instantiate a prefab in the scene

### `async importPrefab(editor, fileName, targetFolderId = null, offset = [0, 0, 0])`

Import prefab from file and instantiate

### `async deletePrefab(editor, fileName)`

Delete prefab file

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
